title: full-control: plan agent-built work
description: Routes explore → design → spec → spec review → go. Nothing is built until the owner says go.

stages.title: Intent
stages.description: Restate the owner's goal, first version, appetite, constraints and done criteria in their words.

outputs.name: goal
outputs.description: goal and done criteria, one paragraph, quoted from the owner

outputs.name: first_version
outputs.description: the owner's one sentence: what the first version does for them

outputs.name: appetite
outputs.description: how many days or weeks the owner says this is worth

outputs.name: other_goals
outputs.description: goals for others (upstream, team, release) the owner named, kept apart and not planned now

gate.prompt: Is this the goal, the first version and the appetite, in your words?

next.when: code, domain or requirements are unclear
the shape is open but the ground is known
the change is small and clear

outputs.name: decision_map
outputs.description: known/unknown quadrants and the decisions they force

outputs.name: observed
outputs.description: each problem in scope: observed (run, repro or log, with the link) or suspected; the owner's use case run once against the current build, or why it could not run

next.when: no design choice is left open

stages.title: Design
stages.description: At least two competing sketches, then a choice.

outputs.name: options
outputs.description: two or more sketches with tradeoffs

gate.prompt: Do you agree with the chosen design?

stages.title: Spec
stages.description: Verifiable slices for the next MR only, in its draft MR/PR description. Later work becomes backlog issues.

outputs.name: slices
outputs.description: slices of the next MR with their checks

outputs.name: size
outputs.description: slice count and three-point estimate of the next MR against intent.appetite, and what was cut

outputs.name: backlog
outputs.description: later work as backlog issues (links), no branches or PRs

gate.name: text_check
gate.description: write-spec scripts/check-forge-text.mjs run on every issue and PR body written in this stage, with its exit code

stages.title: Spec review
stages.description: A fresh-context review on a different model family.

outputs.name: verdict
outputs.description: findings and how each was resolved

gate.name: reviewer
gate.description: which agent and model reviewed, and the run id

stages.title: Go
stages.description: The owner records the go; full-send takes over afterwards.

gate.prompt: Go: build this plan with full-send?
